title: A catastrophe payout has layers
hook: Two stated cases: explore the attachment point of a bounded insurance layer.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the attachment point of a bounded insurance layer affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Payout, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the attachment point of a bounded insurance layer in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
